title: Mobile app version two release planning
lines: Good morning everyone. This is the planning meeting for the version two release of the Pearl Pay mobile app. Omar, Lina, thanks for joining.
Morning. I have the test results from last week, so I can start with those.
We found three bugs in the payment screen. Two are fixed. The third one only happens on older Android phones, and we are still looking at it.
Do we know how many customers still use those phones?
Not yet. I can pull the numbers from the analytics dashboard.
Good. Omar, please send those numbers to the team by Wednesday.
Sure, I will send them by Wednesday.
Next, the release date. Marketing asked for the fifteenth of March.
The fifteenth works for the design team, as long as the new icons are approved this week.
Then let's decide it. We release version two on the fifteenth of March.
Lina, can you get the new icons approved by Friday?
Yes. I will send them to the brand team today and get approval by Friday.
One more decision. We drop the dark mode feature from this release and move it to version two point one.
That makes sense. It needs more testing anyway.
I will update the release notes and share them with the support team next Monday.
What about the price change for international transfers? Will that be in version two?
I don't know yet. Finance hasn't confirmed it. Let's keep that open.
And who will present the release at the all hands meeting?
Good question. We will come back to that. Thanks everyone.
